index_record.dataset_generation_caption: The figure presents two distinct architectures: (a) a Classical Fuzzy Model and (b) a Quantum Fuzzy Neural Network (QFNN) model, arranged vertically. In part (a), the global layout is a left-to-right pipeline starting from 'Classical Data' represented by a blue cylindrical database icon. This data flows into a purple rectangular box labeled 'Preprocessing', which lists steps: Expand Contraction, Stop-Words Removal, Tokenization, Stemming, Frequency Matrix, and Feature Selection. From this, multiple lines labeled '|0⟩' extend to a green rectangular block titled 'Feature Map' under the heading 'Data Encoding'. These lines then feed into a large pink rounded rectangle labeled 'Quantum Fuzzy Neural Networks', containing three sequential modules: two gray rectangles labeled 'QNN Layer U(θi)' and one yellow rectangle labeled 'Fuzzy Layer'. Outputs from these layers proceed to a beige rounded rectangle labeled 'Measurement', which contains three small square icons with diagonal arrows, symbolizing measurement operations. A thick gray arrow leads from Measurement to a light blue rectangle labeled 'Output'. A feedback loop labeled 'Classical Optimization' connects the Output back to the QNN Layers, with an arrow pointing upward to 'Update θi', indicating parameter adjustment. In part (b), the global structure is also a left-to-right flow. It begins with a yellow rectangle labeled 'Data Preprocessing', followed by a gray rectangle labeled 'Cluster Validation'. These feed into a large gray rectangular container housing three light blue vertical rectangles: 'FCM Model', 'Calculate Metrics (PC, PEC)', and 'Predict Clusters'. From this container, two arrows point to a lime green rectangle labeled 'Performance Metrics'. Below the container, a dashed line forms a feedback loop connecting the Performance Metrics to a blue rectangle labeled 'Update Loop', which then loops back to the FCM Model, indicating iterative refinement. The entire figure is captioned: 'Architecture of (a) Classical Fuzzy Model and (b) Quantum Fuzzy Neural Network.'
